snippet.description:
Don’t Make Your UPSC Answer a Treasure Hunt.

In this video, Sonia Gupta Ma’am, Mentorship Head at LevelUp IAS, explains why presentation and readability are important in UPSC Mains answer writing.

Having strong knowledge is not enough if the examiner has to search through your answer to find your key points. Sonia Ma’am explains how Introduction–Body–Conclusion, clear headings, pointers, underlining and proper structuring can make your answers easier to read and help your knowledge stand out.

The goal is simple: if you have the diamond, show it. Don’t make the examiner spend valuable time searching for it.

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 or 2028, understanding answer structure, presentation and readability can help you write more effective Mains answers.
